definition: Communication-avoiding algorithms minimize movement of data within a memory hierarchy for improving its running-time and energy consumption.
details: These minimize the total of two costs (in terms of time and energy): arithmetic and communication. Communication, in this context refers to moving data, either between levels of memory or between multiple processors over a network. It is much more expensive than arithmetic.
story: Imagine a chef tasting every ingredient before it goes into the pot, deciding what belongs and what would ruin the broth. Think of it this way: Communication-avoiding algorithms minimize movement of data within a memory hierarchy for improving its running-time and energy consumption. And here is the clever part: These minimize the total of two costs (in terms of time and energy): arithmetic and communication. It is the raw material; the model is only ever as good as what it was fed. And that is Communication-avoiding algorithm — the unglamorous work everything else stands on.
